notes.title: Patch 0.8.26
notes.content:
After a lot of input from the community, here’s the next patch. Sorted out some heavy bugs and added a few particle animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38118280/10430cd2441fadd2cea148154050c7acf1ee8c19.gif[/img]

[u]Bug reporting[/u]
You’re still very welcome to report all sorts of bugs and feedback. It turns out that the in-game report tool is really handy. But you’re also welcome on our [url=https://discord.gg/HCKKv9Y]Discord server[/url]


[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[i]0.8.26[/i]
 - Fixed freezing after player shoot to the left side in the spaceship
 - Fixed freezing when the third tetromino in spaceship was placed with a wrong rotation 
 - Fixed freezing after first guardian shot
 - Renamed Control Stone to Nexus Stone

[i]0.8.25[/i]
 - Start HP for Rookie reduced from 3 to 2. It’s more challenging now ;-)
 - Changed slightly the Health bar design
 - Spaceship music is stereo. Was strange to hear it just from the right side
 - Added alert sfx for the outpost intro
 - Added alert sfx for the computer
 - Added stereo position for sound effects
 - Gundians sprites polished
 - Added ambient particle effects
 - Added tree grow animation
